p1.title: 📋 Commands · 🛡️ Moderation & 🧰 Server tools
p1.moderation_value:
**/clear `<n>`** — delete the last N messages
**/kick `<member>` `[reason]`** — kick a member
**/ban `<member>` `[reason]`** — ban a member
**/poll** — opens a builder (question + 2-10 options + 1-168h duration, native Discord poll)
**/setwelcome `[channel]`** — welcome message builder
**/warn `<member>` `<reason>`** — warn + auto-timeout past the threshold
**/modlogs `<member>`** — sanction history
**/clearwarns `<member>` `[reason]`** — revoke every warn
**/note `<member>` `<text>`** — internal mod note (no DM)
**Automod** (TookBot+) — banned-word filters, anti-ads, mention anti-spam and anti-raid, all configurable from the dashboard
p1.tempvoice_value:
**/tempvoice setup `<lobby>` `[category]` `[default_name]`** — admin: set up the lobby channel
**/tempvoice info** — admin: view the current config
**/tempvoice disable** — admin: turn the feature off
**/voc rename `<name>`** — rename your temp channel
**/voc limit `<number>`** — cap the member count
**/voc lock / unlock** — lock / reopen the channel
**/voc kick `<member>`** — remove a member from the channel
**/voc transfer `<member>`** — hand over ownership
p1.tools_value:
**/reaction_add / remove / list** — auto reactions on a member
**/rolereaction create** — role-reaction builder
**/socialalert add / list / remove** — Twitch/YT/Reddit alerts
**/ticket** — ticket panel builder
**/giveaway create / list / reroll / cancel** — giveaways
**/cmd `<name>`** — run a custom command (TookBot+, dashboard builder)
**Server analytics** — dashboard page with live stats, heatmap, top commands / top users

p2.title: 📋 Commands · 🎉 Fun · ⭐ XP · ⚔️ Duel · 🎵 Music
p2.xp_value:
**/level `[member]`** — show level + XP
**/leaderboard** — server top 10 XP
p2.duel_value:
**/duel fight `<opponent>` `[nerf]`** — lightsaber challenge (defense mindgame)
**/duel info** — full guide to the system
**/profile `[member]`** — duel profile
**/statpoint `<stat>`** — spend a stat point
**/saber** — saber menu (equipped / collection / shop)
**/history `[member]`** — duel history
p2.music_value:
**/join** **/leave** — join / leave your voice channel
**/play `<title|link>`** — YouTube, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, Spotify (track/album/playlist)
**/search `<query>`** — pick from 5 YouTube results
**/queue** **/nowplaying** — full queue / current track
**/skip `[position]`** **/remove `<position>`** — skip / drop a track
**/volume `<0-200>`** **/pause** **/resume** **/stop**
**/musicstats `[period]`** — top tracks and top listeners

p3.title: 📋 Commands · 🎮 Counter-Strike 2 & 🔧 Utilities
p3.cs_value:
**/cs link `<platform>` `<id>`** — link a Steam or Faceit account
**/cs unlink `<platform>`** — drop a link
**/cs stats `[member]`** — Steam / Faceit stats
**/cs setrank `<elo>`** — declare your Premier ELO + rank role
**/cs rankrole on|off** — admin: automatic rank role assignment
**/cs price `<weapon>` `<skin>` `[wear]` `[stattrak]`** — Steam + Skinport price
**/cs inventory `[member|steamid]`** — CS2 inventory + € value
**/cs queue** — temporary 5-slot voice channel
**/cs map** — ban/pick maps with the people in your voice channel
**/cs loadout** — random loadout
p3.utils_value:
**/avatar `[member]`** — a member's avatar
**/userinfo `[member]`** — detailed member info
**/serverinfo** — server info
**/ping** — bot latency
**/tweet `<message_id>`** — tweet-style card image of a message
**/remind** — reminder builder (date, message, channel)
**/reminders** — list your pending reminders
**/unremind `<id>`** — cancel a reminder
**/vote** — vote for TookBot on top.gg
**/invite** — official invite link
**/commands** — show this help again in DM

p4.title: 📋 Commands · 🃏 Cards — collection & economy
p4.collection_value:
**/roll `[universe]`** — draw 1 random card. Cooldown **1h per server** (each server has its own timer). Grants Essences ✨ based on rarity
**/cardcollec `[member]` `[rarity]`** — your collection (✨ = cosmetic, ⭐ = fusion)
**/card `<name>`** — full details of a card (autocomplete over 19k+)
**/show `<card>`** — show off one of your cards with its border + stars
p4.essences_value:
**/essences `[member]`** — your Essence ✨ balance
**/daily** — daily reward (TookCoins + Essences, streak)
**/cardshop** — shop: buy cards & cosmetics with your Essences
**/cardrecycle `<card>` `[qty]`** — recycle your duplicates into Essences
p4.fusion_value:
**/cardfuse `<card>`** — fuse duplicates to add a star (max 5). A fused card becomes non-tradable
**/cardup `<rarity>`** — sacrifice duplicate 5⭐ cards for 1 random card of the rarity above
**/cardcustom `<card>` `<border>`** — apply a border (consumed on use)
**/cardinventory `[member]`** — your cosmetics in stock
p4.events_value:
**/eventfight** — event fight: send your best card matching the element of the day (3/day) to earn event tokens
**/eventshop** — spend your event tokens (rolls, essence bonuses, skins)

p5.title: 📋 Commands · 🃏 Cards — social & profile
p5.profile_value:
**/cardprofile `[member]`** — card profile (stats, combat power, image of your 3 featured cards)
**/cardprofile `custom:true`** — editor: pick your 3 featured cards + your profile color
**/cardtop `<category>`** — global leaderboards (value, mythics, essences, fusions, luck)
p5.wishlist_value:
**/cardwish `<card>`** — add/remove from your wishlist (3 max, **6 on the support server**). You get pinged when someone rolls it
**/cardwishlist `[member]`** — view a wishlist (🗑 buttons to remove)
p5.trade_value:
**/cardtrade `<player>`** — multi-card trade (Accept / Decline / Counter-offer)
**/cardsuggest** — suggest a character to add (community 🔼/🔽 vote)
**/cardmodify `<card>`** — suggest an edit to an existing card (rarity, universe, image...)
p5.combat_value:
Your cards have a **combat power** (HP + ATK ×2, plus a bonus per fusion), shown on **/cardprofile**.
**Raid bosses** — they spawn in the cards channel: everyone hits to deal damage, and loot is split between the participants on a win. Difficulty scales with the rarity of the group's avatars.
p5.setup_value:
**/cardsetup `<channel>` `[role]`** — cards channel + ping role on drop/boss
**/cardsetup_disable** — lift the restriction
**/cardhelp** — full guide to the card system

p6.title: 📋 Commands · 🛡️ Guilds (clubs)
p6.base_value:
Guilds are **cross-server clubs** (up to 30 members) that gain levels (max 60) and unlock **passive bonuses** for every member.
**/guild create `<name>` `[tag]`** — create a guild (costs Essences ✨)
**/guild info `[name]`** — a guild's sheet (yours by default)
**/guildprofile `[name]`** — rich profile: level, total power, members, bank, shop
**/guild top** — guild leaderboard
p6.members_value:
**/guild invite `<member>`** — invite someone (Master / Officer)
**/guild accept `<name>`** — join a guild that invited you
**/guild leave** — leave your guild
**/guild kick `<member>`** — remove someone (Master / Officer)
**/guild promote / demote `<member>`** — manage officers (Master)
**/guild transfer `<member>`** — hand over mastership (Master)
**/guild disband** — disband the guild (Master)
p6.xp_value:
The guild earns **XP** when its members roll, beat a boss, spin the wheel, fuse or donate to the bank.
**/guild donate `<amount>`** — feed the bank (unlocked at a tier)
Tier bonuses: **% essences**, **% XP**, **shorter roll cooldown** (down to −10 min), **+1 roll/h at level 60**, **+ wishlist slots**, **% boss loot**, bank, guild shop and profile colors (a new unlock every 5 levels).

modperms.intro_description:
Hey **{owner}**!

This channel is **private** (only you and the bot can see it) and will be **deleted** automatically once the configuration is done.

**1.** Pick the Discord role that stands for your server's **moderators**.
**2.** Select the **slash commands** your mods are allowed to use.
**3.** Select the **dashboard pages** they can open.
**4.** Click **Save**.

💡 *You can change these rights at any time from `dashboard.tookbot.click/mod-config`.*
